words.en: (a measure word for series or sets of things) set; suite
words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 套 like the apartment measure — 几套房子, 一套.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers count apartments/suits as 套. 课文 is house-hunting.

example.pinyin: Shàng cì nín kàn le jǐ tào fángzi?
example.en: How many apartments did you see last time?

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 房子 like the place to rent — 看房子, 租房子.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean a house or flat. Here: rental apartments.

example.pinyin: Wǒ zài dài nín qù kàn jǐ tào ba.
example.en: Let me take you to see a few more.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 满意 like the verdict after viewing — 都不太满意.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 满意 / 不满意 with a choice. 要是你也满意，咱们就租了.

example.pinyin: Kàn le sān tào, dōu bú tài mǎnyì.
example.en: I saw three — none were very satisfactory.

words.en: some; part of a group of people or things
words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 有的 like ‘some (of them)’ — 有的太小，有的…….
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers pair 有的…有的… for some…others….

example.zh: 有的太小，有的周围环境太乱。
example.pinyin: Yǒude tài xiǎo, yǒude zhōuwéi huánjìng tài luàn.
example.en: Some are too small; some have chaotic surroundings.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 周围 like the area around the flat — 周围环境.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers describe 周围环境 for neighborhood quality.

example.pinyin: Zhōuwéi huánjìng zěnmeyàng?
example.en: How’s the surrounding environment?

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 环境 like neighborhood feel — 环境特别好.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers judge housing by 环境. Paired with 周围.

example.pinyin: Huánjìng tèbié hǎo.
example.en: The environment is especially good.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 乱 like messy surroundings — 环境太乱.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean disorderly/chaotic. Here: noisy messy area.

example.pinyin: Yǒude zhōuwéi huánjìng tài luàn.
example.en: Some have chaotic surroundings.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 厨房 like one room that is 还可以.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean kitchen. Compared with 客厅面积.

example.zh: 厨房、卧室还可以，但是客厅面积小了点儿。
example.pinyin: Chúfáng, wòshì hái kěyǐ, dànshì kètīng miànjī xiǎo le diǎnr.
example.en: The kitchen and bedroom are okay, but the living room is a bit small.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 卧室 like the bedroom that is 还可以.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean bedroom in apartment talk.

example.pinyin: Chúfáng, wòshì hái kěyǐ.
example.en: The kitchen and bedroom are okay.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 客厅 like the room that’s too small — 客厅面积.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean living room. Size measured in 平米.

example.pinyin: Kètīng miànjī xiǎo le diǎnr.
example.en: The living room is a bit small.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 面积 like floor area — 客厅面积, 30多平米.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers quote apartment size as 面积.

example.zh: 楼上18层有一套，客厅30多平（方）米。
example.pinyin: Lóushàng shíbā céng yǒu yí tào, kètīng sānshí duō píng(fāng)mǐ.
example.en: There’s one on the 18th floor — living room over 30 square meters.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 层 like floor number — 18层.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers count floors with 层.

example.pinyin: Lóushàng shíbā céng yǒu yí tào.
example.en: There’s one on the 18th floor upstairs.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 平（方）米 like the area unit — 30多平米.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers say 平米 / 平方米 for floor area.

example.pinyin: Kètīng sānshí duō píng(fāng)mǐ.
example.en: The living room is over 30 square meters.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 上去 like going upstairs to see — 咱们上去看看吧.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 上去 for going up. Directional complement.

example.pinyin: Zánmen shàngqu kànkan ba.
example.en: Let’s go up and take a look.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 阳光 like daylight in the flat — 上下午都有阳光.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers care about 阳光 when renting. 注释 on 还是 choice.

example.zh: 我还是想要上下午都有阳光的。
example.pinyin: Wǒ háishi xiǎng yào shàngxiàwǔ dōu yǒu yángguāng de.
example.en: I’d still rather have one with sun morning and afternoon.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 还是 like the choice after comparing — 我还是想要….
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 还是 for ‘better to… / still prefer…’ after weighing options (见注释).

example.zh: 我还是想要上下午都有阳光的。
example.pinyin: Wǒ háishi xiǎng yào shàngxiàwǔ dōu yǒu yángguāng de.
example.en: I’d still rather have one with sun morning and afternoon.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 妻子 like 小张’s wife in 课文（二）.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean wife (more formal than 老婆).

example.pinyin: Zěnme xiànzài cái xiàbān?
example.en: How come you’re only getting off work now?

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 堵车 like the jam that made her late — 路上堵车堵得厉害.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 堵车 for traffic jams. Book prints spaced dǔ chē.

example.pinyin: Lùshang dǔchē dǔ de lìhai.
example.en: The traffic jam on the way was terrible.

words.en: to make a dash for; to hurry
words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 赶 like rushing home — 就往回赶.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 赶回去 / 往回赶 when rushing.

example.zh: 我下了班就往回赶，到现在才到家。
example.pinyin: Wǒ xià le bān jiù wǎng huí gǎn, dào xiànzài cái dào jiā.
example.en: I headed home as soon as I got off — only just arriving now.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 才 like late/only then — 怎么现在才下班, 才到家 (grammar vs 就).
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 才 for lateness or ‘only then.’ Contrast with 就.

example.pinyin: Zěnme xiànzài cái xiàbān?
example.en: How come you’re only getting off work now?

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 要是 like if — 要是你也满意，咱们就租了.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 要是……就…… for hypotheticals (语法).

example.zh: 要是你也满意，咱们就租了。
example.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ yě mǎnyì, zánmen jiù zū le.
example.en: If you’re happy with it too, we’ll rent it.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 租 like signing the lease — 咱们就租了.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 租房子. Related 房租.

example.zh: 要是你也满意，咱们就租了。
example.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ yě mǎnyì, zánmen jiù zū le.
example.en: If you’re happy with it too, we’ll rent it.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 房租 like the monthly price — 房租多少钱？
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers ask 房租 for rent amount.

example.pinyin: Fángzū duōshao qián?
example.en: How much is the rent?

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 虽然 like conceding cost — 虽然贵了点儿，但是房子真好.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 虽然……但是…… (语法).

example.zh: 虽然贵了点儿，但是房子真好。
example.pinyin: Suīrán guì le diǎnr, dànshì fángzi zhēn hǎo.
example.en: Though it’s a bit expensive, the apartment is really nice.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 真 like emphasis — 房子真好.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 真 + adj for strong praise.

example.zh: 虽然贵了点儿，但是房子真好。
example.pinyin: Suīrán guì le diǎnr, dànshì fángzi zhēn hǎo.
example.en: Though it’s a bit expensive, the apartment is really nice.

words.en: a measure word for rivers, fish, legs, etc.
words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 条 like the river measure — 一条小河.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers count rivers/roads with 条.

example.pinyin: Shān xiàbian yǒu yì tiáo xiǎo hé.
example.en: Below the mountain there’s a small river.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 河 like the river by the park.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean river. 河边是公园.

example.zh: 河边是一个很大的公园。
example.pinyin: Hé biān shì yí ge hěn dà de gōngyuán.
example.en: Beside the river is a big park.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 交通 like getting to work — 交通很方便.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers judge housing by 交通.

example.pinyin: Jiāotōng fāngbiàn bu fāngbiàn?
example.en: Is the transportation convenient?

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 方便 like easy access — 很方便.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers 方便 for convenience.

example.pinyin: Jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn.
example.en: Transportation is very convenient.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 公共汽车 like the bus stop downstairs.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers say 公共汽车 / 公交. Book prints spaced form.

example.pinyin: Lóuxià jiù yǒu gōnggòng qìchē zhàn.
example.en: There’s a bus stop right downstairs.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 站 like a stop — 公共汽车站, 地铁站.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean station/stop.

example.zh: 坐车十分钟就到公司了。
example.pinyin: Zuò chē shí fēnzhōng jiù dào gōngsī le.
example.en: Ten minutes by bus and you’re at the company.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 车站 like the stop next to the subway.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean bus/train station.

example.zh: 汽车站旁边就是地铁站。
example.pinyin: Qìchēzhàn pángbiān jiù shì dìtiě zhàn.
example.en: Right beside the bus stop is the subway station.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 旁边 like next to — 旁边就是地铁站.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers locate things 在…旁边.

example.zh: 汽车站旁边就是地铁站。
example.pinyin: Qìchēzhàn pángbiān jiù shì dìtiě zhàn.
example.en: Right beside the bus stop is the subway station.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 地铁 like the subway stop nearby.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean metro/subway.

example.zh: 汽车站旁边就是地铁站。
example.pinyin: Qìchēzhàn pángbiān jiù shì dìtiě zhàn.
example.en: Right beside the bus stop is the subway station.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 附近 like nearby amenities — 附近有学校、医院…
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers list what’s 附近.

example.zh: 附近有学校、医院和体育馆。
example.pinyin: Fùjìn yǒu xuéxiào, yīyuàn hé tǐyùguǎn.
example.en: Nearby there are schools, a hospital, and a gymnasium.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 体育馆 like one of the nearby facilities.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean sports hall/gymnasium.

example.zh: 附近有学校、医院和体育馆。
example.pinyin: Fùjìn yǒu xuéxiào, yīyuàn hé tǐyùguǎn.
example.en: Nearby there are schools, a hospital, and a gymnasium.

lines.speaker: 业务员
lines.zh: 张先生，这么早！
lines.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng, zhème zǎo!
lines.en: Mr. Zhang — so early!

lines.speaker: 小张
lines.zh: 是啊。我吃了早饭就来了。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Wǒ chī le zǎofàn jiù lái le.
lines.en: Yeah. I came right after breakfast.

lines.speaker: 业务员
lines.zh: 我也是。接了您的电话，八点半就到这儿了。上次您看了几套房子？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě shì. Jiē le nín de diànhuà, bā diǎn bàn jiù dào zhèr le. Shàng cì nín kàn le jǐ tào fángzi?
lines.en: Me too. After your call I was here by 8:30. How many apartments did you see last time?

lines.speaker: 小张
lines.zh: 看了三套，都不太满意。有的太小，有的周围环境太乱。
lines.pinyin: Kàn le sān tào, dōu bú tài mǎnyì. Yǒude tài xiǎo, yǒude zhōuwéi huánjìng tài luàn.
lines.en: Three — none were great. Some too small; some with chaotic surroundings.

lines.speaker: 业务员
lines.zh: 我再带您去看几套吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài dài nín qù kàn jǐ tào ba.
lines.en: Let me take you to see a few more.

lines.speaker: 小张
lines.zh: 这几套房子，厨房、卧室还可以，但是客厅面积小了点儿。有没有大一点儿的？
lines.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tào fángzi, chúfáng, wòshì hái kěyǐ, dànshì kètīng miànjī xiǎo le diǎnr. Yǒu méiyǒu dà yìdiǎnr de?
lines.en: These ones — kitchen and bedroom are okay, but the living room is a bit small. Any bigger ones?

lines.speaker: 业务员
lines.zh: 有，楼上18层有一套，客厅30多平（方）米。咱们上去看看吧。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu, lóushàng shíbā céng yǒu yí tào, kètīng sānshí duō píng(fāng)mǐ. Zánmen shàngqu kànkan ba.
lines.en: Yes — one on the 18th floor, living room over 30㎡. Let’s go up and look.

lines.speaker: 小张
lines.zh: 这套房子下午就没有阳光了吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhè tào fángzi xiàwǔ jiù méiyǒu yángguāng le ba?
lines.en: This one won’t have sun in the afternoon, right?

lines.speaker: 业务员
lines.zh: 是的。
lines.pinyin: Shì de.
lines.en: That’s right.

lines.speaker: 小张
lines.zh: 我还是想要上下午都有阳光的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ háishi xiǎng yào shàngxiàwǔ dōu yǒu yángguāng de.
lines.en: I’d still rather have one with sun morning and afternoon.

dialogues.label: 课文（二）
dialogues.headingEn: I got off work long ago

lines.speaker: 小张
lines.zh: 怎么现在才下班？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme xiànzài cái xiàbān?
lines.en: How come you’re only getting off work now?

lines.speaker: 妻子
lines.zh: 我早就下班了。路上堵车堵得厉害。我下了班就往回赶，到现在才到家。你今天看了几套房子？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zǎo jiù xiàbān le. Lùshang dǔchē dǔ de lìhai. Wǒ xià le bān jiù wǎng huí gǎn, dào xiànzài cái dào jiā. Nǐ jīntiān kàn le jǐ tào fángzi?
lines.en: I got off long ago. Terrible jam on the way — I rushed back after work and only just got home. How many apartments did you see today?

lines.speaker: 小张
lines.zh: 看了七八套。有一套我觉得不错。等你休息的时候，再一起去看看。要是你也满意，咱们就租了。
lines.pinyin: Kàn le qī-bā tào. Yǒu yí tào wǒ juéde búcuò. Děng nǐ xiūxi de shíhou, zài yìqǐ qù kànkan. Yàoshi nǐ yě mǎnyì, zánmen jiù zū le.
lines.en: Seven or eight. One seemed nice. When you’re free we’ll go look together. If you like it too, we’ll rent it.

lines.speaker: 妻子
lines.zh: 房租多少钱？
lines.pinyin: Fángzū duōshao qián?
lines.en: How much is the rent?

lines.speaker: 小张
lines.zh: 一个月五千块。
lines.pinyin: Yí ge yuè wǔ qiān kuài.
lines.en: Five thousand a month.

lines.speaker: 妻子
lines.zh: 怎么这么贵？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme zhème guì?
lines.en: Why so expensive?

lines.speaker: 小张
lines.zh: 虽然贵了点儿，但是房子真好。
lines.pinyin: Suīrán guì le diǎnr, dànshì fángzi zhēn hǎo.
lines.en: A bit pricey, but the apartment is really nice.

lines.speaker: 妻子
lines.zh: 周围环境怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Zhōuwéi huánjìng zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: How’s the surrounding environment?

lines.speaker: 小张
lines.zh: 环境特别好。西边是山，山下边有一条小河，河边是一个很大的公园。周围非常安静。
lines.pinyin: Huánjìng tèbié hǎo. Xībian shì shān, shān xiàbian yǒu yì tiáo xiǎo hé, hé biān shì yí ge hěn dà de gōngyuán. Zhōuwéi fēicháng ānjìng.
lines.en: Especially good. Mountains to the west, a small river below, a big park by the river. Very quiet around.

lines.speaker: 妻子
lines.zh: 交通方便不方便？
lines.pinyin: Jiāotōng fāngbiàn bu fāngbiàn?
lines.en: Is transportation convenient?

lines.speaker: 小张
lines.zh: 交通很方便。楼下就有公共汽车站，坐车十分钟就到公司了。汽车站旁边就是地铁站。附近有学校、医院和体育馆……
lines.pinyin: Jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn. Lóuxià jiù yǒu gōnggòng qìchē zhàn, zuò chē shí fēnzhōng jiù dào gōngsī le. Qìchēzhàn pángbiān jiù shì dìtiě zhàn. Fùjìn yǒu xuéxiào, yīyuàn hé tǐyùguǎn……
lines.en: Very convenient. Bus stop downstairs — ten minutes to the company. Subway right beside. Schools, hospital, gym nearby…

notes.title: 这几套房子，厨房、卧室还可以，但是客厅面积小了点儿。
notes.body: “形容词＋了（一）点儿”指跟某一个标准相比，程度不合适。表示不满意。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Kètīng miànjī xiǎo le diǎnr.
example.en: The living room is a bit small.

notes.title: 我还是想要上下午都有阳光的。
notes.body: “还是”表示比较后做出选择，有“这样比较好或这么办比较好”的意思。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.zh: 我还是想要上下午都有阳光的。
example.pinyin: Wǒ háishi xiǎng yào shàngxiàwǔ dōu yǒu yángguāng de.
example.en: I’d still rather have one with sun morning and afternoon.

notes.title: “就”和“才”
notes.body: 副词“就”和“才”都可以放在动词前面作状语。“就”可表即将发生，也表早、快、容易、顺利；“才”可表刚刚发生，也表晚、慢、不容易、不顺利。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Wǒ chī le zǎofàn jiù lái le.
example.en: I came right after breakfast.

notes.title: 要是……就……
notes.body: “要是……就……”连接两个分句，表示在假设情况下产生某种结果。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.zh: 要是你也满意，咱们就租了。
example.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ yě mǎnyì, zánmen jiù zū le.
example.en: If you’re happy with it too, we’ll rent it.

notes.title: 虽然……但是……
notes.body: “虽然……但是……”连接两个分句，表示转折关系。先肯定“虽然”后的事实，再突出“但是”后的意思。“但是”可以单用。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.zh: 虽然贵了点儿，但是房子真好。
example.pinyin: Suīrán guì le diǎnr, dànshì fángzi zhēn hǎo.
example.en: Though it’s a bit expensive, the apartment is really nice.
